definitions.short: Babel (i.e. Babylon), including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire
definitions.full: H894. Babel בָּבֶ֫ל 262 proper name, of a location Babel, Babylon (in Assyrian written Bab-ilu, gate of god Dl Pa 212 , compare on other hand Jen Kosmol. 498 ) — with ָ ה locative בָּבֶ֫לָה Ezek 12:13 +, בָּבֶ֑לָה 2Kin 20:17 +? מִבָּבֶ֫לָה Jer 27:16 ; — the ancient capital of Babylonia, modern Hillah , situated on Euphrates, in long. approximately 440 30° east, and latitude approximately 320 50° north; Gen 10:10 ; 11:9 (where name connected with בלל confuse, confound ), both J, not elsewhere in Hexateuch; 2Kin 17:24 31 t. 2Kings; 18t. Chronicles; Est 2:6 ; late Psa 87:4 ; 137:1 ; 137:8 ; Isa 2 ; Isa 3 , namely Isa 13:1 , 19 ; 14:4 , 22 ; 21:9 ; 39:1 , 3 , 6 , 7 ; 43:14 ; 47:1 ; 48:14 , 20 ; Micah 4:10 (but here probably not original, compare RS Proph. vii. n. 5 & references ) Zech 2:11 ; 6:10 ; Dan 1:1 ; Ezek 12:13 19 t. Ezekiel; Jer 20:4 (twice in verse); 20:5-6 , 165t. Jeremiah — note especially בּ ׳אֶרֶץ 50:28 ; also of land & people = realm, particular in בּ ׳מֶלֶךְ 2Kin 20:12 of Merodach Baladan; 20:18 ; 24:1 , 7 , 11 , 12 (twice in verse) + often of Nebuchadrezzar; 25:27 = Jer 52:31 compare 52:34 of Evil-Merodach; Neh 13:6 of Artaxerxes; the city personified as בָּבֶל בַּת Isa 47:1 ; Jer 50:42 .
